{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Charcoal wool-blend blazer tailored with a structured shoulder and straight hemline in #2F3135
Crisp white silk blouse with a modest collar in #FFFFFF
High-waisted black pleated trousers with a sleek crease in #0A0A0A
Black leather ankle boots with a low block heel in #000000

This outfit honors her request for smart and classic registers by combining the structured silhouette of a wool blazer with the refined elegance of silk and leather. The charcoal and black palette works exceptionally well under artificial club lighting while remaining versatile enough to stand out in a crowded rock concert environment without drawing excessive attention. By choosing a sharp, monochromatic look, the ensemble balances the need for sophistication with the energetic atmosphere of an evening at a venue where she plans to walk through crowds."}
